name: HAL SUPREME
description: Free/community AI companion with Fast / Build / Expert / Council modes. OpenAI-compatible peer gateway plus MCP tools (search, images, voice, code sandbox, chat). Authorized peers only — no anonymous free-for-all. Stub Agent Card for A2A discovery alignment; full A2A task protocol is roadmap.

bearer.bearerFormat: opaque peer/gateway token issued by operator (placeholder: <HAL_GATEWAY_TOKEN>)
bearer.description: Authorization: Bearer <HAL_GATEWAY_TOKEN>. Tokens are scoped, rate-limited, and issued out-of-band. No secrets are embedded in this card.

skills.name: OpenAI-compatible chat
skills.description: Chat completions via POST /v1/chat/completions. Models: hal/fast, hal/coder, hal/deep, hal/council. List via GET /v1/models; peer identity via GET /v1/peers.
examples: Point OpenCode / OpenAI-compatible client at https://api.halsupreme.com/v1 with apiKey <HAL_GATEWAY_TOKEN>

skills.name: MCP gateway tools
skills.description: Local stdio MCP gateway exposing community tools such as web_search, generate_image, chat, run_code, and Piper voice. See community docs for mcp.json placeholders (no secrets).
examples: Register as MCP server in Cursor / Claude Desktop with placeholders only
